name: Brycen
source:
Brycen is very playful. He tends to downplay himself, but he's very passionate about his work. He wants to make sure the person he falls for is always laughing and smiling. When they're feeling down, he'll always be there to cheer them up with his jokes.

[From [url=https://chanimk.itch.io/mixed-feelings-demo]itch.io[/url]]
